name: call_chain
description: Callers/callees at a specific line. Use when you know line but not symbol name. For symbol-level, use impact_analysis.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

line.description: Line number of the function to analyze. Provide this OR symbol (at least one required).

symbol.description: Symbol name to analyze. Provide this OR line (at least one required). If both provided, symbol takes precedence.
